posts.title: Realising I probably have ADHD

This is in large part because of two things; 1- Reading Normally Weird and Weirdly Normal by Robin Ince 2- My partner's continued dropping of hints and a “you don't have to tell me” upon me talking about the book. posts.title: Struggling to Keep AI Out
